## hasValue() function

Tests whether a dot-separated path resolves to a non-nullish value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
hasValue: <T, Path extends PartialDottedKeys<T> = PartialDottedKeys<T>>(data: T, path: Path) => data is T & { [path in Path]: NonNullable<FieldType<T, path>>; }
```

**Returns:**

data is T &amp; { \[path in Path\]: NonNullable&lt;[FieldType](./morpho-ts.fieldtype.md)<!-- -->&lt;T, path&gt;&gt;; }

`true` when the value at `path` is neither `null` nor `undefined`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { hasValue } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const data = { user: { name: "Ada" as string | null } };
const result = hasValue(data, "user.name");
// true
```
